zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Montville Township Central, North, South, and Hill sections
keyFindings: Homeowners fund 84.1% of the total property tax levy in Montville Township.
Average annual property tax check is $16,197.50, representing 9.3% of median household income.
Public school district receives 66.2% of every property tax dollar paid by residents.

keyTakeaways.title: Why Schools Take 66.2% of Every Tax Check in Montville Township
keyTakeaways.detail: Because Montville Township is classified as an affluent suburban district under NJ SFRA school aid formulas, State Aid covers roughly 10% of educational spending. Local property taxpayers must fund the remaining ~90%.

keyTakeaways.title: Commercial Ratable Retention vs. PILOT Burdens
keyTakeaways.detail: Commercial ratables represent 15.9% of Montville Township's tax base. Protecting business ratables while ensuring that new luxury developments pay their fair share to the school district is the central taxpayer challenge.
